Flow.description: Screen flow launched via quick action from a GiftCommitment record. Presents six actions that correspond to the Nonprofit Cloud Fundraising Operations managed-package flows (frops_flo namespace): Close Gift Commitment, Get Gift Commitments, Manage Gift Commitment Schedule, Manage Gift Designations, Pause | Resume, and Update Recurring Schedule. PLACEHOLDER MODE: each route currently ends on a screen that tells the user which frops_flo flow to run and how to open it. Once the package is installed in the target org, swap each Placeholder_* screen for a matching Subflow element (flowName = frops_flo__CloseGiftCommitment / GetGiftCommitments / ManageGiftCmtSchedule / ManageGiftDesignations / PauseResumeSchedule / UpdateRecurringSchedule) that forwards recordId.

choices.name: Choice_Close
choices.choiceText: Close Gift Commitment — mark this commitment Closed and update related gift transactions

choices.name: Choice_Get
choices.choiceText: Get Gift Commitments — retrieve active commitments for this donor

choices.name: Choice_Schedule
choices.choiceText: Manage Gift Commitment Schedule — create or update recurring and custom schedules

choices.name: Choice_Designations
choices.choiceText: Manage Gift Designations — assign designations to this commitment or its transactions

choices.name: Choice_PauseResume
choices.choiceText: Pause | Resume — pause the schedule for a fixed period (or indefinitely), or resume it

choices.name: Choice_UpdateRecurring
choices.choiceText: Update Recurring Schedule — modify the recurring schedule details

decisions.name: Decide_Action
decisions.label: Route to Fundraising Operations flow
decisions.description: Routes the user's choice to the matching placeholder screen. Once the frops_flo managed package is installed, replace each connector target with a subflow that invokes the corresponding frops_flo__* flow.

fields.name: PlaceholderClose_Body

Close Gift Commitment

This would run the frops_flo__CloseGiftCommitment managed flow — updating this commitment's status to Closed and cascading status changes to related gift transactions.

Run it directly from Setup → Flows, or open a Salesforce admin to swap this placeholder for the real subflow.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input: Id of the GiftCommitment from which the flow is launched. Passed automatically by the Lightning quick action. Once placeholders are replaced with subflow calls, this value gets forwarded to each frops_flo__* flow verbatim.
